# GeneExprLupusMx

The goal of GeneExprLupusMx is to provide a bilingual, reproducible R
data package that integrates transcriptomic profiles and clinical
metadata from Mexican women with systemic lupus erythematosus and
healthy controls. By combining gene expression data from monocytes,
monocyte-derived dendritic cells (moDCs), and tolerogenic dendritic
cells (tolDCs), the package enables:

- **Educational use:** serving as a teaching resource in bioinformatics,
  immunology, and biomedical sciences.

- **Comparative analysis:** supporting exploration of gene regulation
  networks and differential expression studies.

- **Reproducible workflows:** offering auxiliary functions and scripts
  to replicate figures and analyses from the original study.

- **Global integration:** making locally generated datasets visible and
  usable in international research contexts.

- **Scientific outreach:** promoting open science and the dissemination
  of biomedical data from Latin America.

## Installation

You can install the development version of GeneExprLupusMx from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r













# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("EveliaCoss/GeneExprLupusMx")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r













library(GeneExprLupusMx)
## basic example code
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`?
You can include R chunks like so:

``` r













summary(metadata_cleaned)
#>    sample_ID   Group     GC      Dose    Dose_category      Age    
#>  QR011_0: 1   Ctrl:30   No:57   0  :57   0:57          19     : 9  
#>  QR011_1: 1   SLE :69   Si:42   2.5: 6   1:42          27     : 9  
#>  QR011_3: 1                     3  : 3                 35     : 9  
#>  QR013_0: 1                     5  :30                 23     : 6  
#>  QR013_1: 1                     8  : 3                 25     : 6  
#>  QR013_3: 1                                            32     : 6  
#>  (Other):93                                            (Other):54  
#>     Cell_type   Group_age  Nephritis Other_tx  Sledai_score
#>  moDC    :33   less30:39   No :60    No :12   0      :18   
#>  monocyte:33   more30:60   Si : 9    Si :57   2      : 6   
#>  tolDC   :33               NAs:30    NAs:30   4      : 6   
#>                                               6      : 6   
#>                                               14     : 6   
#>                                               (Other):27   
#>                                               NAs    :30   
#>            Sledai_group SLEDAI_Md    SLEDAI_category
#>  High            :12    No :30    Activity   :39    
#>  Low             :21    Si :36    No_activity:12    
#>  Moderate        : 6    Sí : 3    Zero       :48    
#>  Very_high       :15    NAs:30                      
#>  Without_activity:15                                
#>  NAs             :30                                
#> 
```

You’ll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md`
up-to-date.
[`devtools::build_readme()`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/reference/build_readme.html)
is handy for this.

``` r













str(filtered_txi)
#> List of 4
#>  $ abundance          : num [1:21718, 1:99] 7.504 2.357 0 0.228 0.36 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:21718] "A1BG" "A1BG-AS1" "A1CF" "A2M" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:99] "QR011_0" "QR011_1" "QR011_3" "QR013_0" ...
#>  $ counts             : num [1:21718, 1:99] 179 70 0 16 11 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:21718] "A1BG" "A1BG-AS1" "A1CF" "A2M" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:99] "QR011_0" "QR011_1" "QR011_3" "QR013_0" ...
#>  $ length             : num [1:21718, 1:99] 1489 1853 8956 4376 1910 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:21718] "A1BG" "A1BG-AS1" "A1CF" "A2M" ...
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:99] "QR011_0" "QR011_1" "QR011_3" "QR013_0" ...
#>  $ countsFromAbundance: chr "no"
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Reduce_GOTerm()`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/Reduce_GOTerm.md)
  : Batch Reduce and Visualize GO Terms Across Multiple Datasets
- [`biotype_summary`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/biotype_summary.md)
  : Gene biotypes
- [`create_heatmap()`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/create_heatmap.md)
  : Create a ComplexHeatmap with row annotation
- [`dc_genes`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/dc_genes.md)
  : Genes associated with dendritic cell differentiation and function
- [`dds`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/dds.md)
  : DESeqDataSet checkpoint from the RNA-seq lesson
- [`de_celltype_results`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/de_celltype_results.md)
  : Differential expression results: dendritic cells vs monocytes
- [`de_interaction_results`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/de_interaction_results.md)
  : Differential expression results: between-group comparison of
  contrasts
- [`de_results`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/de_results.md)
  : Differential expression results checkpoint (SLE vs Ctrl by cell
  type)
- [`filtered_txi`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/filtered_txi.md)
  : Gene-level RNA-seq quantification (tximport)
- [`get_heatmap_mat()`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/get_heatmap_mat.md)
  : Generate a heatmap-ready matrix from a DESeq2 object
- [`go_celltype_results`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/go_celltype_results.md)
  : Functional enrichment checkpoint: dendritic cells vs monocytes
  (g:Profiler)
- [`go_interaction_results`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/go_interaction_results.md)
  : Functional enrichment checkpoint: between-group comparison of
  contrasts (g:Profiler)
- [`go_results`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/go_results.md)
  : Functional enrichment results checkpoint (g:Profiler)
- [`isg_genes`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/isg_genes.md)
  : Interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs)
- [`metadata_cleaned`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/metadata_cleaned.md)
  : Sample metadata: group, cell type and clinical information
- [`moDC_genes`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/moDC_genes.md)
  : Genes described in the differentiation of monocytes into moDCs
- [`processGO()`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/processGO.md)
  : Process GO Enrichment Result from a Single File
- [`sle_genes`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/sle_genes.md)
  : Genes associated with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)
- [`tolDC_genes`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/tolDC_genes.md)
  : Transcriptional signature of tolerogenic dendritic cells (tolDCs)
- [`volunteer_info`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/volunteer_info.md)
  : Clinical information per volunteer
- [`zscore_mat`](https://eveliacoss.github.io/GeneExprLupusMx/reference/zscore_mat.md)
  : Z-score matrix checkpoint from the RNA-seq lesson
